name: Heart Wrencher / zero-action-points
notes: Printed Heart Wrencher yellow is a Mechanologist attack action with cost0, power2, and exactly Boost. CR8.3.9 makes banishing the top deck card optional additional cost; banishing a Mechanologist grants this attack go again, while other top cards do not. Empty deck prevents paying Boost but does not prevent ordinary play. Dash young has only an optional start-game item setup ability, and no item is started in these main-phase fixtures. No Hyper Driver, Teklo Pounder, High Octane, equipment or other boost modifiers exist. Player1 cannot play: own turn but no action points. Source remains in hand; no Boost choice, banish, payment or priority-stack mutation may happen. Deck order/count and health are unchanged.
